rows.commentary: 0.1: Keemo Paul charges in at a searing 141 clicks, hitting a menacing length that bites away from Sanju Samson's hesitant prod.

0.2: Keemo Paul charges in at 135 kph, angling back sharply into Sanju Samson, who finds himself hopelessly cramped and can only jab it away into the off-side for a hurried single to get India off the mark.
0.3: Wide from Keemo Paul to Abhishek Sharma.
0.3: Keemo Paul oversteps on the delivery, serving up a wide free-hit as Abhishek Sharma flails wildly at the massive away swinger well outside off stump.
0.3: Keemo Paul bowls a wide to Abhishek Sharma, 5 runs in all.
0.3: Dot ball from Keemo Paul to Abhishek Sharma.
0.4: Keemo Paul delivers, and Abhishek Sharma launches it cleanly over the ropes for the opening maximum of the night.

0.5: Keemo Paul delivers from back of a length into middle and leg, catching Abhishek Sharma's attempted flick short of elevation and straight into the waiting hands of Shamar Joseph leaping at mid-wicket.
0.6: Keemo Paul rushes Ishan Kishan on the crease with a hurried length into the ribs, forcing a quick tuck out to mid-wicket for a sharp single.
1.1: Romario Shepherd drops it back of a length on middle and leg, and Ishan Kishan stands his ground to whip it effortlessly over fine leg into the stands for a maximum.
1.2: Romario Shepherd continues to Ishan Kishan, who steers this delivery down toward the third-man region to comfortably pick up a pair of runs.
1.3: Ishan Kishan finds the boundary off Romario Shepherd for four.
1.4: Romario Shepherd delivers into the channel, and Ishan Kishan adjusts in a flash, dropping to one knee to carve a magnificent scoop over fine leg that sails all the way out of the ground!
1.5: Romario Shepherd hunts for Ishan Kishan as the batter shifts across the crease, but his radar deserts him entirely as he sprays this delivery miles down the leg-side.
1.5: Romario Shepherd drops it full outside off, Kishan flashes hard across the line, and the outside edge balloons safely over short third man for four.
1.6: Ishan Kishan takes a single off Romario Shepherd.
2.1: Shamar Joseph bangs it in on a back of a length outside off, and Ishan Kishan brilliantly arches back to carve it over the cover region for a brisk boundary, sending India soaring to forty-two.
2.2: Shamar Joseph bowls a wide to Ishan Kishan.
2.2: Shamar Joseph rolls his fingers across the seam at one hundred twenty-three kays, dropping it short outside off as Ishan Kishan uncorks a fierce slash over point to scamper back for two.
2.3: Shamar Joseph strikes with raw pace as Ishan Kishan lofts it into the grateful hands of Rovman Powell, ending a blistering cameo of thirty.
2.4: Shamar Joseph digs this back of a length into the ribs, and Shreyas Iyer works it cleanly through mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
2.5: Shamar Joseph drags it short and wide outside off, and Sanju Samson brutally carves it away to the fence, bringing up the team fifty for India in style.
2.6: Shamar Joseph offers a fraction of width outside off, and Sanju Samson treats it with absolute elegance, sending the short delivery sailing for six.
3.1: Shreyas Iyer takes 2 off Gudakesh Motie.
3.2: Gudakesh Motie drops it slightly short outside off, and Shreyas Iyer punches firmly towards long-off with a rigid bat, settling for just a single as the sweet spot eludes him.
3.3: Four to Sanju Samson off Gudakesh Motie.
3.4: Motie drops it short into the middle and leg channel, allowing Samson to muscle a pull straight out to deep mid-wicket for a sharp single.
3.5: No run for Shreyas Iyer off Gudakesh Motie.
3.6: Gudakesh Motie serves up a full toss, and Shreyas Iyer shifts across his crease to swipe it through mid-wicket, comfortably scampering back for a busy couple of runs.

4.1: Shamar Springer strikes instantly with his very first delivery, slanting it into Sanju Samson on a length and grazing the seam before the off-stump cartwheels out of the ground to dismiss him for 16.
4.2: A single to Tilak Varma off Shamar Springer.
4.3: Shamar Springer delivers on a length around middle and leg, and Shreyas Iyer heaves it out to deep mid-wicket to pick up a couple of runs.
4.4: Shamar Springer lands it full and straight on middle and leg, allowing Shreyas Iyer to stroke it along the carpet toward long-on for a single.
4.5: Shamar Springer bowls a wide to Tilak Varma.
4.5: Shamar Springer offers a full toss outside off and Tilak Varma swings hard, failing to middle the stroke as the ball rolls away to long-off for a single.
4.6: A single to Shreyas Iyer off Shamar Springer.
5.1: Dot ball from Gudakesh Motie to Shreyas Iyer.
5.2: Gudakesh Motie bowls a wide to Shreyas Iyer.
5.2: Gudakesh Motie errs in length, and Shreyas Iyer finally finds the middle to crash a boundary.
5.3: Gudakesh Motie floats it up full, inviting Shreyas Iyer to skip down the track and loft it straight down the ground just shy of the ropes.
5.4: Gudakesh Motie draws the stroke from Shreyas Iyer, sending it high toward deep mid-off where the chance goes down, allowing three comfortable runs.
5.5: Motie loops it up, and Varma forces the heave away into the deep mid-wicket turf, settling for a brisk single.
5.6: Wide from Gudakesh Motie to Shreyas Iyer.
5.6: Motie fires in a low full toss around middle and leg, and Iyer swings hard, dragging an inside edge away toward short fine leg for a single.
6.1: Keemo Paul digs it in short, Shreyas Iyer miscues the pull into the deep, and Shamar Joseph settles underneath it to end a sluggish innings.
6.2: Naman Dhir clears the boundary off Keemo Paul for six.
6.3: Four to Naman Dhir off Keemo Paul.
6.4: Keemo Paul feeling the heat as he digs it in short and wide, miles away from Naman Dhir's flailing blade.
6.4: Keemo Paul delivers into the channel outside off, and Naman Dhir pounces on the width, launching it effortlessly over long-off to bring up the team century in style.
6.5: Keemo Paul unleashes a searing, full delivery into the stumps, stabbed away through the leg side by Naman Dhir to collect a brisk single in the deep.
6.6: Tilak Varma takes 2 off Keemo Paul.
7.1: Six to Naman Dhir off Shamar Springer.
7.2: A single to Naman Dhir off Shamar Springer.
7.3: Springer tries to take pace off the ball against Tilak Varma, but slips it well wide of the tramline.
7.3: Shamar Springer delivers a low full toss that Tilak Varma whips away, prompting a searing sprint and acrobatic dive from Keemo Paul at deep mid-wicket to save two.
7.4: Shamar Springer shatters the resistance, beating Tilak Varma all ends up to send the timber flying and end a brisk knock of seven.
